publication: Val Tannen, Friendly Logics, Fall 2015, Lecture Notes 3. University of Pennsylvania author PDF, 7 pages; printed page equals PDF page.

reviews.checked_passages: §2 printed 3–5: Theorem 2.1 and its proof, Exercises 2.1–2.3, Corollary 2.3; §1 printed 2 finite truth-evaluation discussion.
reviews.consumers: Existential–universal sentences: witness bound, finite structure tables, model checking and satisfiability decision.
reviews.outcome: TANNEN-FL-01: original-signature constant values must be included in the model bound. The entry uses max(1,m+c), proves the corrected result directly and gives a two-constant counterexample. Database applications and complexity lower bounds are outside this inspection.
